name: Warren Woods Public Schools
notes: FEDERAL FILING ANOMALY, not an unread policy. This state prohibits corporal punishment in public schools by statute (see data/states), yet the district's 2023-24 CRDC filing reports students receiving it. The project's analysis of these filings (facts/claims/crdc-ban-state-reports-2023-24.md) finds the pattern consistent with restraint or seclusion miscoded as corporal punishment. No district policy permitting the practice can exist lawfully here; the open question is the filing, which belongs to the district and to OCR. Closed 2026-09-24; reopen if the district or OCR corrects the filing.
